interpretation: softwareRhi=true is software command recording followed by native DX12 replay/submission; not software GPU emulation.
Baseline full-summary and ETW ON differ in sample count and instrumentation. Do not compare their timings as a code change.
CPU marker means are inclusive. Record DispatchJoin includes DependencyGraph; parent and child are not additive.
Translation runs on RHIThread and replay scopes run on workers. Owner Waiting is a scheduler/join symptom, not idle-time proof or removable work.
Logical target worker numbers differ from physical Worker thread labels. Per-target work sums are not wall critical path.
GPU figures are sums/means of measured pass timestamps, not GPU queue interval unions or displayed FPS.
No native-software bypass A/B capture, full CPU allocation profile, latest Release capture, or per-command hardware-counter attribution is in this selected baseline.
Stored quality flags do not prove pixel correctness; pixelAcceptance/nativeQualityGateEligible are false.
This extraction downloaded summaries/conditions only, no raw ETW threads/kernel rows or full frames.
